objective: Add a bounded adapter that runs and verifies an RLSOK standalone Shadow evaluation without dispatching robot commands.
acceptance: RLSOK is invoked without a shell and with bounded time and output
Shadow output requires zero controller goals and hardwareSignalSent false
EvidenceBundle is bounded, parsed strictly, and verified against the supplied release
missing or malformed external results fail closed
evidence: validated Shadow EvidenceBundle with hardwareSignalSent false
stop_conditions: integration requires a frozen interface change
